text: K2 has a carving error. If K4 has one too, a missing or extra letter shifts every later known letter against its carved letter, and tests that count places fail for the wrong reason.
The copper with one letter taken out at each of 97 places, or an unknown letter put in at each of 98: 196 versions, each run through two exact tests.
Neither the chained plaintext autokey (lags 1 to 25) nor two secret words of total length up to 20 fits any version.
